name: Lycaon Resources Limited
summary: Lycaon Resources Limited, a Perth-based explorer created in 2021, works mainly in Western Australia seeking gold, nickel, copper, cobalt, silver, base metals and platinum group elements. Projects include Gnewing Bore in the Kimberley Region and Rocky Dam, about 162.8 square kilometers northeast of Kalgoorlie, and it also holds the Julimar project.
